package converted

// This file is a non-production, synthetic HTTP fixture. Its cookie and request-token
// checks are test boundaries, not authentication or CSRF assurance for an application.

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"html"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/cookiejar"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/mail"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const (
	p05CookieName       = "appkit_p05_fixture"
	p05MaxBody          = 8 << 10
	p05MaxSessions      = 32
	p05DefaultLabel     = "Contact email"
	p05DefaultError     = "Use an email address permitted by this synthetic fixture."
	p05BlockedEmail     = "blocked@example.test"
	p05SuccessfulEmail  = "person@example.test"
	p05BrowserServeWait = 10 * time.Minute
)

type p05Session struct {
	token      string
	requestSeq uint64
	theme      string
	label      string
	failNext   bool
	savedValue string
	saveCount  int
}

type p05Fixture struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	sessions map[string]*p05Session
	order    []string
	next     uint64
	css      string
	original string
	defaults EmailField
}

func newP05Fixture(css, original string, defaults EmailField) *p05Fixture {
	if defaults.ID == "" {
		defaults.ID = "contact-email"
	}
	if defaults.Name == "" {
		defaults.Name = "contact_email"
	}
	if defaults.Label == "" {
		defaults.Label = p05DefaultLabel
	}
	if defaults.Placeholder == "" {
		defaults.Placeholder = p05SuccessfulEmail
	}
	if defaults.Error == "" {
		defaults.Error = p05DefaultError
	}
	return &p05Fixture{
		sessions: make(map[string]*p05Session),
		css:      css,
		original: original,
		defaults: defaults,
	}
}

func (f *p05Fixture) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	f.setHeaders(w)
	if !p05LoopbackRequest(r) {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusForbidden, "This synthetic fixture accepts only direct loopback requests.")
		return
	}
	if r.Method == http.MethodPost && !p05SameOrigin(r) {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusForbidden, "This synthetic form must be submitted from the same origin.")
		return
	}
	switch {
	case r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/demo":
		f.startDemo(w, r)
	case r.Method == http.MethodPost && r.URL.Path == "/save":
		f.save(w, r)
	case r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/done":
		f.done(w, r)
	case r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/reference-original":
		f.referenceOriginal(w, r)
	case r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/reference-adapted":
		f.referenceAdapted(w, r)
	default:
		http.NotFound(w, r)
	}
}

func (f *p05Fixture) setHeaders(w http.ResponseWriter) {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(f.cssText()))
	styleHash := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; style-src 'sha256-"+styleHash+"'; font-src data:; img-src data:; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
	// Chrome native navigation POSTs under no-referrer serialize Origin as null.
	// same-origin preserves the local POST origin without cross-origin referrers.
	w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "same-origin")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
}

func (f *p05Fixture) startDemo(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	theme := r.URL.Query().Get("theme")
	if theme == "" {
		theme = "light"
	}
	if theme != "light" && theme != "dark" {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Choose the light or dark theme.")
		return
	}
	label := p05DefaultLabel
	if r.URL.Query().Get("long") == "1" {
		label = "Contact email used for important synthetic account notices and recovery updates"
	}

	f.mu.Lock()
	f.next++
	id := p05Opaque("session", f.next)
	s := &p05Session{token: p05Opaque("token-"+id, 1), requestSeq: 1, theme: theme, label: label, failNext: true}
	f.sessions[id] = s
	f.order = append(f.order, id)
	for len(f.order) > p05MaxSessions {
		delete(f.sessions, f.order[0])
		f.order = f.order[1:]
	}
	view := *s
	f.mu.Unlock()

	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
		Name: p05CookieName, Value: id, Path: "/", HttpOnly: true,
		SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode, MaxAge: 3600,
	})
	field := EmailField{ID: "contact-email", Name: "email", Label: label, Placeholder: p05SuccessfulEmail, Required: true}
	f.renderDemo(w, http.StatusOK, &view, field, "", "")
}

func (f *p05Fixture) save(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, s, ok := f.session(r)
	if !ok {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Start a fresh synthetic session before saving.")
		return
	}
	if r.ContentLength > p05MaxBody {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "The submitted form is too large.")
		return
	}
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, p05MaxBody)
	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil {
		var tooLarge *http.MaxBytesError
		if errors.As(err, &tooLarge) {
			f.problem(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "The submitted form is too large.")
			return
		}
		f.problem(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "The submitted form could not be read.")
		return
	}
	if len(r.PostForm) != 2 {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Submit exactly the expected form fields.")
		return
	}
	token, tokenOK := p05One(r.PostForm, "request_token")
	emailValue, emailOK := p05One(r.PostForm, "email")
	if !tokenOK || !emailOK {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Submit each expected form field exactly once.")
		return
	}
	if len(emailValue) > 4096 {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "The synthetic email value is too long.")
		return
	}

	f.mu.Lock()
	current, stillPresent := f.sessions[id]
	if !stillPresent || current != s || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(token), []byte(current.token)) != 1 {
		f.mu.Unlock()
		f.problem(w, http.StatusForbidden, "This synthetic session is no longer current.")
		return
	}
	current.requestSeq++
	current.token = p05Opaque("token-"+id, current.requestSeq)
	if !p05EmailSyntax(emailValue) || emailValue == p05BlockedEmail {
		errText := "Enter one complete email address."
		if emailValue == p05BlockedEmail {
			errText = "That synthetic address is blocked. Use person@example.test."
		}
		field := EmailField{ID: "contact-email", Name: "email", Label: current.label, Value: emailValue, Placeholder: p05SuccessfulEmail, Error: errText, Required: true, Autofocus: true}
		view := *current
		f.mu.Unlock()
		f.renderDemo(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, &view, field, "", "")
		return
	}
	if current.failNext {
		current.failNext = false
		field := EmailField{ID: "contact-email", Name: "email", Label: current.label, Value: emailValue, Placeholder: p05SuccessfulEmail, Required: true}
		view := *current
		f.mu.Unlock()
		f.renderDemo(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, &view, field, "We could not save the synthetic email yet.", "Nothing was lost. Check the retained value and retry.")
		return
	}
	current.savedValue = emailValue
	current.saveCount++
	f.mu.Unlock()
	http.Redirect(w, r, "/done", http.StatusSeeOther)
}

func (f *p05Fixture) done(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	_, s, ok := f.session(r)
	if !ok {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Start a fresh synthetic session to view a confirmation.")
		return
	}
	f.mu.Lock()
	value := s.savedValue
	theme := s.theme
	f.mu.Unlock()
	if value == "" {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusConflict, "No synthetic email has been saved in this session.")
		return
	}
	var body bytes.Buffer
	io.WriteString(&body, `<main><section class="card" aria-labelledby="saved-title"><p class="eyebrow">Synthetic fixture</p><h1 id="saved-title">Email saved</h1><p>The saved synthetic value is <strong>`)
	io.WriteString(&body, html.EscapeString(value))
	io.WriteString(&body, `</strong>.</p><p>Refreshing this confirmation performs only another GET.</p><a href="/demo?theme=`)
	io.WriteString(&body, html.EscapeString(theme))
	io.WriteString(&body, `">Start a fresh session</a></section></main>`)
	f.page(w, http.StatusOK, "Synthetic email saved", theme, body.String())
}

func (f *p05Fixture) renderDemo(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, s *p05Session, field EmailField, summary, guidance string) {
	component, err := NewEmailField(field)
	if err != nil {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "The synthetic field could not be rendered.")
		return
	}
	var body bytes.Buffer
	io.WriteString(&body, `<main class="fixture-controls"><section class="card" aria-labelledby="page-title"><p class="eyebrow">Synthetic settings fixture</p><h1 id="page-title">Contact email</h1><p>Test validation and recovery without sending or retaining real email.</p>`)
	if summary != "" {
		io.WriteString(&body, `<div id="save-error-summary" class="summary" role="alert" tabindex="-1" autofocus><h2>`)
		io.WriteString(&body, html.EscapeString(summary))
		io.WriteString(&body, `</h2><p>`)
		io.WriteString(&body, html.EscapeString(guidance))
		io.WriteString(&body, `</p><a href="#contact-email">Review the retained email</a></div>`)
	}
	io.WriteString(&body, `<form method="post" action="/save"><input type="hidden" name="request_token" value="`)
	io.WriteString(&body, html.EscapeString(s.token))
	io.WriteString(&body, `">`)
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &body); err != nil {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "The synthetic field could not be rendered.")
		return
	}
	io.WriteString(&body, `<button type="submit">Save synthetic email</button></form><nav aria-label="Fixture references"><a href="/reference-original">Original reference</a> <a href="/reference-adapted">Adapted reference</a></nav></section></main>`)
	title := "Contact email synthetic fixture"
	if summary != "" {
		title = "Could not save synthetic email"
	}
	f.page(w, status, title, s.theme, body.String())
}

func (f *p05Fixture) referenceOriginal(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	theme := r.URL.Query().Get("theme")
	if theme == "" {
		theme = "light"
	}
	if theme != "light" && theme != "dark" {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Choose the light or dark theme.")
		return
	}
	body := f.original
	if body == "" {
		body = `<p class="reference-note">No local original was supplied for this isolated run.</p>`
	}
	f.page(w, http.StatusOK, "Email field reference", theme, `<main><section class="card"><h1>Email field reference</h1><div class="reference-specimen">`+body+`</div></section></main>`)
}

func (f *p05Fixture) referenceAdapted(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	theme := r.URL.Query().Get("theme")
	if theme == "" {
		theme = "light"
	}
	if theme != "light" && theme != "dark" {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Choose the light or dark theme.")
		return
	}
	component, err := NewEmailField(f.defaults)
	if err != nil {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "The adapted reference defaults are invalid.")
		return
	}
	var body bytes.Buffer
	io.WriteString(&body, `<main><section class="card"><h1>Email field reference</h1><div class="reference-specimen">`)
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &body); err != nil {
		f.problem(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "The adapted reference could not be rendered.")
		return
	}
	io.WriteString(&body, `</div></section></main>`)
	f.page(w, http.StatusOK, "Email field reference", theme, body.String())
}

func (f *p05Fixture) page(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, title, theme, body string) {
	if theme != "dark" {
		theme = "light"
	}
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	io.WriteString(w, `<!doctype html><html lang="en" class="`+theme+`"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>`)
	io.WriteString(w, html.EscapeString(title))
	io.WriteString(w, `</title><style>`+f.cssText()+`</style></head><body>`+body+`</body></html>`)
}

func (f *p05Fixture) problem(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, message string) {
	f.page(w, status, "Synthetic fixture request problem", "light", `<main><section class="card"><h1>Request not accepted</h1><p>`+html.EscapeString(message)+`</p><a href="/demo">Start a fresh synthetic session</a></section></main>`)
}

func (f *p05Fixture) session(r *http.Request) (string, *p05Session, bool) {
	cookie, err := r.Cookie(p05CookieName)
	if err != nil || cookie.Value == "" {
		return "", nil, false
	}
	f.mu.Lock()
	s, ok := f.sessions[cookie.Value]
	f.mu.Unlock()
	return cookie.Value, s, ok
}

func (f *p05Fixture) cssText() string {
	css := f.css
	if css == "" {
		css = `body{font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;background:#f8fafc;color:#111827}.dark body{background:#111827;color:#f9fafb}`
	}
	return css + `
body{margin:0;line-height:1.5}main{max-width:48rem;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 1rem}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:.75rem;padding:1.5rem}.dark .card{background:#1f2937;border-color:#4b5563}.card h1{font-size:1.875rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:.25rem 0 1rem}.card p{max-width:65ch}.eyebrow{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.summary{border:2px solid #b91c1c;border-radius:.5rem;padding:1rem;margin:1rem 0}.fixture-controls input:not([type=hidden]),.fixture-controls button{min-height:44px}.fixture-controls button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:0;border-radius:.5rem;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font:inherit;font-weight:700;margin-top:1.25rem;padding:.65rem 1rem}.fixture-controls button:hover{background:#4338ca}.fixture-controls :focus{outline:3px solid #4f46e5;outline-offset:3px}.reference-specimen{margin-top:1.5rem}
.fixture-controls a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}.fixture-controls nav{display:flex;gap:.25rem 1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1rem}.summary h2{font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.5rem}.summary p{margin-bottom:.25rem}.dark .fixture-controls :focus{outline-color:#a5b4fc}`
}

func p05LoopbackRequest(r *http.Request) bool {
	remoteHost, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(r.RemoteAddr)
	remoteIP := net.ParseIP(remoteHost)
	if err != nil || remoteIP == nil || !remoteIP.IsLoopback() {
		return false
	}
	local, ok := r.Context().Value(http.LocalAddrContextKey).(net.Addr)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	localHost, localPort, err := net.SplitHostPort(local.String())
	localIP := net.ParseIP(localHost)
	if err != nil || localIP == nil || !localIP.IsLoopback() {
		return false
	}
	requestHost, requestPort, err := net.SplitHostPort(r.Host)
	if err != nil || requestPort != localPort {
		return false
	}
	requestIP := net.ParseIP(requestHost)
	return requestIP != nil && requestIP.IsLoopback() && requestIP.Equal(localIP)
}

func p05SameOrigin(r *http.Request) bool {
	origin := r.Header.Get("Origin")
	if origin == "" {
		return true
	}
	parsed, err := url.Parse(origin)
	return err == nil && parsed.Scheme == "http" && parsed.Host == r.Host && parsed.User == nil && parsed.Path == "" && parsed.RawQuery == "" && parsed.Fragment == ""
}

func p05Opaque(kind string, n uint64) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("appkit-p05-%s-%d", kind, n)))
	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:16])
}

func p05One(values url.Values, key string) (string, bool) {
	v, ok := values[key]
	return func() (string, bool) {
		if !ok || len(v) != 1 {
			return "", false
		}
		return v[0], true
	}()
}

func p05EmailSyntax(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value || strings.Count(value, "@") != 1 {
		return false
	}
	parsed, err := mail.ParseAddress(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.Address == value
}

func p05ReadLocal(path string, limit int64) (string, error) {
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("fixture asset is not a regular file")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if int64(len(data)) > limit {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("fixture asset exceeds %d bytes", limit)
	}
	return string(data), nil
}

func p05BrowserFixture() (*p05Fixture, error) {
	var css, original string
	var err error
	if path := os.Getenv("APPKIT_P05_CSS"); path != "" {
		css, err = p05ReadLocal(path, 4<<20)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_CSS: %w", err)
		}
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(css), "</style") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_CSS contains an HTML style terminator")
		}
	}
	if path := os.Getenv("APPKIT_P05_ORIGINAL"); path != "" {
		original, err = p05ReadLocal(path, 1<<20)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_ORIGINAL: %w", err)
		}
		lower := strings.ToLower(original)
		if strings.Contains(lower, "<script") || strings.Contains(lower, "</style") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_ORIGINAL contains active or scaffold-breaking markup")
		}
	}
	defaults := EmailField{ID: "fixture-email", Name: "fixture_email", Label: p05DefaultLabel, Placeholder: p05SuccessfulEmail, Error: p05DefaultError}
	if path := os.Getenv("APPKIT_P05_DEFAULTS"); path != "" {
		raw, readErr := p05ReadLocal(path, 64<<10)
		if readErr != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_DEFAULTS: %w", readErr)
		}
		decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(raw))
		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := decoder.Decode(&defaults); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_DEFAULTS: %w", err)
		}
		if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_DEFAULTS: trailing JSON")
		}
	}
	if _, err := NewEmailField(defaults); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("APPKIT_P05_DEFAULTS: %w", err)
	}
	return newP05Fixture(css, original, defaults), nil
}

var p05TokenPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`name="request_token" value="([^"]+)"`)

func p05ReadResponse(t *testing.T, response *http.Response) string {
	t.Helper()
	defer response.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2<<20))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(body)
}

func p05Token(t *testing.T, body string) string {
	t.Helper()
	match := p05TokenPattern.FindStringSubmatch(body)
	if len(match) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("request token missing from form")
	}
	return match[1]
}

func p05Client(t *testing.T) *http.Client {
	t.Helper()
	jar, err := cookiejar.New(nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return &http.Client{Jar: jar, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
}

func p05Post(t *testing.T, client *http.Client, endpoint, token, emailValue string) (*http.Response, string) {
	t.Helper()
	values := url.Values{"request_token": {token}, "email": {emailValue}}
	response, err := client.PostForm(endpoint+"/save", values)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return response, p05ReadResponse(t, response)
}

func TestEmailFieldNativeRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newP05Fixture("", "", EmailField{})
	server := httptest.NewServer(fixture)
	defer server.Close()
	client := p05Client(t)

	initial, err := client.Get(server.URL + "/demo?theme=dark")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	initialBody := p05ReadResponse(t, initial)
	if initial.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(initialBody, `type="email"`) || !strings.Contains(initialBody, `required`) || !strings.Contains(initialBody, `action="/save"`) || strings.Contains(initialBody, `aria-invalid`) || !strings.Contains(initialBody, `class="dark"`) || !strings.Contains(initial.Header.Get("Content-Security-Policy"), "form-action 'self'") || !strings.Contains(initial.Header.Get("Content-Security-Policy"), "font-src data:") || strings.Contains(initialBody, "<script") {
		t.Fatal("initial GET did not expose the neutral native email form in the retained theme")
	}
	if !p05EmailSyntax(p05BlockedEmail) {
		t.Fatal("the app-rejected fixture address must remain native-email-valid")
	}
	token := p05Token(t, initialBody)

	blocked, blockedBody := p05Post(t, client, server.URL, token, p05BlockedEmail)
	if blocked.StatusCode != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity || !strings.Contains(blockedBody, `value="`+p05BlockedEmail+`"`) || !strings.Contains(blockedBody, `aria-invalid="true"`) || !strings.Contains(blockedBody, `autofocus`) || !strings.Contains(blockedBody, "That synthetic address is blocked") || !strings.Contains(blockedBody, `class="dark"`) {
		t.Fatal("synthetic domain rejection did not retain and focus the associated invalid field")
	}
	token = p05Token(t, blockedBody)

	unavailable, unavailableBody := p05Post(t, client, server.URL, token, p05SuccessfulEmail)
	if unavailable.StatusCode != http.StatusServiceUnavailable || !strings.Contains(unavailableBody, `<title>Could not save synthetic email</title>`) || !strings.Contains(unavailableBody, `value="`+p05SuccessfulEmail+`"`) || strings.Contains(unavailableBody, `aria-invalid`) || !strings.Contains(unavailableBody, `id="save-error-summary"`) || !strings.Contains(unavailableBody, `tabindex="-1" autofocus`) || strings.Count(unavailableBody, "autofocus") != 1 || !strings.Contains(unavailableBody, `href="#contact-email"`) || !strings.Contains(unavailableBody, `class="dark"`) {
		t.Fatal("injected save failure did not retain a neutral field and focus retry guidance")
	}
	token = p05Token(t, unavailableBody)

	saved, savedBody := p05Post(t, client, server.URL, token, p05SuccessfulEmail)
	if saved.StatusCode != http.StatusSeeOther || saved.Header.Get("Location") != "/done" || savedBody != "" {
		t.Fatal("successful retry did not use a 303 confirmation redirect")
	}
	confirmation, err := client.Get(server.URL + "/done")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	confirmationBody := p05ReadResponse(t, confirmation)
	if confirmation.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(confirmationBody, p05SuccessfulEmail) || !strings.Contains(confirmationBody, "performs only another GET") || !strings.Contains(confirmationBody, `class="dark"`) {
		t.Fatal("confirmation GET did not report the saved synthetic value")
	}
	refresh, err := client.Get(server.URL + "/done")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = p05ReadResponse(t, refresh)
	fixture.mu.Lock()
	saves := 0
	for _, session := range fixture.sessions {
		saves += session.saveCount
	}
	fixture.mu.Unlock()
	if refresh.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || saves != 1 {
		t.Fatal("refresh resubmitted or changed the synthetic save")
	}
}

func TestEmailFieldRequestBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newP05Fixture("", "", EmailField{})
	server := httptest.NewServer(fixture)
	defer server.Close()

	withoutSession, err := http.PostForm(server.URL+"/save", url.Values{"request_token": {"none"}, "email": {p05SuccessfulEmail}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = p05ReadResponse(t, withoutSession)
	if withoutSession.StatusCode != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatal("save without a scoped session was accepted")
	}

	client := p05Client(t)
	initial, err := client.Get(server.URL + "/demo?theme=light&long=1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	initialBody := p05ReadResponse(t, initial)
	if initial.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(initialBody, "important synthetic account notices") {
		t.Fatal("long-label fresh session was not rendered")
	}
	setCookies := initial.Cookies()
	if len(setCookies) != 1 || !setCookies[0].HttpOnly || setCookies[0].Path != "/" || setCookies[0].SameSite != http.SameSiteStrictMode {
		t.Fatal("fixture cookie was not scoped as expected")
	}
	token := p05Token(t, initialBody)
	foreignValues := url.Values{"request_token": {token}, "email": {p05SuccessfulEmail}}
	foreignRequest, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, server.URL+"/save", strings.NewReader(foreignValues.Encode()))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	foreignRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
	foreignRequest.Header.Set("Origin", "http://127.0.0.1:1")
	for _, cookie := range client.Jar.Cookies(foreignRequest.URL) {
		foreignRequest.AddCookie(cookie)
	}
	foreign, err := client.Do(foreignRequest)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = p05ReadResponse(t, foreign)
	if foreign.StatusCode != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatal("foreign POST origin was accepted")
	}

	foreignHostRequest, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, server.URL+"/demo", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	foreignHostRequest.Host = "example.test"
	foreignHost, err := client.Do(foreignHostRequest)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = p05ReadResponse(t, foreignHost)
	if foreignHost.StatusCode != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatal("foreign Host was accepted")
	}

	wrong, wrongBody := p05Post(t, client, server.URL, "wrong-session-token", p05SuccessfulEmail)
	if wrong.StatusCode != http.StatusForbidden || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(wrongBody), "email saved") {
		t.Fatal("wrong request token crossed the session boundary")
	}

	for name, values := range map[string]url.Values{
		"duplicate": {"request_token": {token}, "email": {p05SuccessfulEmail, "second@example.test"}},
		"extra":     {"request_token": {token}, "email": {p05SuccessfulEmail}, "unexpected": {"value"}},
		"missing":   {"request_token": {token}},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, server.URL+"/save", strings.NewReader(values.Encode()))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
			for _, cookie := range client.Jar.Cookies(request.URL) {
				request.AddCookie(cookie)
			}
			response, err := client.Do(request)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			body := p05ReadResponse(t, response)
			if response.StatusCode != http.StatusBadRequest || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(body), "email saved") {
				t.Fatal("invalid form cardinality was accepted")
			}
		})
	}

	large := strings.Repeat("x", p05MaxBody+1)
	request, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, server.URL+"/save", strings.NewReader(large))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
	for _, cookie := range client.Jar.Cookies(request.URL) {
		request.AddCookie(cookie)
	}
	response, err := client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = p05ReadResponse(t, response)
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge {
		t.Fatal("oversized form body was not rejected")
	}

	for _, route := range []string{"/reference-original?theme=dark", "/reference-adapted?theme=dark"} {
		reference, err := client.Get(server.URL + route)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		referenceBody := p05ReadResponse(t, reference)
		if reference.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(referenceBody, `<title>Email field reference</title>`) || !strings.Contains(referenceBody, `<h1>Email field reference</h1>`) || !strings.Contains(referenceBody, `class="dark"`) {
			t.Fatalf("reference route %s did not preserve the shared dark scaffold", route)
		}
	}

	oldest := p05Client(t)
	oldestResponse, err := oldest.Get(server.URL + "/demo")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = p05ReadResponse(t, oldestResponse)
	for i := 0; i < p05MaxSessions; i++ {
		fresh := p05Client(t)
		freshResponse, err := fresh.Get(server.URL + "/demo")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_ = p05ReadResponse(t, freshResponse)
	}
	evicted, err := oldest.Get(server.URL + "/done")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = p05ReadResponse(t, evicted)
	fixture.mu.Lock()
	count := len(fixture.sessions)
	fixture.mu.Unlock()
	if count != p05MaxSessions || evicted.StatusCode != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatal("bounded session store did not evict its oldest session")
	}
}

func TestEmailFieldConcurrentTokenRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newP05Fixture("", "", EmailField{})
	server := httptest.NewServer(fixture)
	defer server.Close()
	client := p05Client(t)
	initial, err := client.Get(server.URL + "/demo")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	initialBody := p05ReadResponse(t, initial)
	token := p05Token(t, initialBody)
	cookies := client.Jar.Cookies(initial.Request.URL)
	if len(cookies) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("scoped session cookie missing")
	}

	type result struct {
		status int
		err    error
	}
	results := make(chan result, 2)
	start := make(chan struct{})
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		go func() {
			<-start
			values := url.Values{"request_token": {token}, "email": {p05SuccessfulEmail}}
			request, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, server.URL+"/save", strings.NewReader(values.Encode()))
			if err != nil {
				results <- result{err: err}
				return
			}
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
			request.AddCookie(cookies[0])
			response, err := client.Do(request)
			if err != nil {
				results <- result{err: err}
				return
			}
			_, readErr := io.Copy(io.Discard, io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2<<20))
			closeErr := response.Body.Close()
			if readErr == nil {
				readErr = closeErr
			}
			results <- result{status: response.StatusCode, err: readErr}
		}()
	}
	close(start)
	counts := map[int]int{}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		got := <-results
		if got.err != nil {
			t.Fatal(got.err)
		}
		counts[got.status]++
	}
	if counts[http.StatusServiceUnavailable] != 1 || counts[http.StatusForbidden] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("same request token crossed concurrent session boundary: statuses=%v", counts)
	}
}

func TestEmailFieldBrowserServer(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("APPKIT_P05_SERVE") != "1" {
		t.Skip("set APPKIT_P05_SERVE=1 for the isolated browser fixture")
	}
	fixture, err := p05BrowserFixture()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(fixture)
	defer server.Close()
	fmt.Printf("APPKIT_P05_URL=%s\n", server.URL)

	interrupt := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(interrupt, os.Interrupt)
	defer signal.Stop(interrupt)
	timer := time.NewTimer(p05BrowserServeWait)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-interrupt:
	case <-timer.C:
	}
}
